title: Table of Contents Title Wrapping
description: The table of content wraps titles into 2 lines although there would be plenty of space for the titles
summary: Adjusted Table of Contents / Register column widths in print/tex/semio-table.sty to allocate more space for titles (from 62% to 78%) and reduce excess spacing for keys (16% to 12%) and page numbers (22% to 10%).
